champion: Papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary
ordered_diagnoses: Papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary

key_facts: Patient is 71 years old
Initial diagnosis of stage IIIC papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary
Initial treatment included resection and 6 cycles of adjuvant paclitaxel/carboplatin
Developed liver and cecal metastases one year after initial treatment
Underwent multiple treatments over seven years
Developed metastases to right pleura, abdominal masses, and new liver and splenic metastases
Negative for germline mutation
Positive for somatic mutation
CA125 levels increased from 145.6 to 271.7
CT scans showed progressive disease with hepatic and splenic lesions
BRCA-1 mutation detected in metastatic tumor tissue and ctDNA analyses

s4.champion: Papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary

raw.champion: Papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary
raw.rationale: The patient's initial diagnosis and the presence of a BRCA-1 mutation, which is commonly associated with ovarian cancer, support this diagnosis. The patient's disease progression and metastases are also consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: High-grade serous carcinoma
rejected.why: While high-grade serous carcinoma is a subtype of ovarian cancer, the patient's initial diagnosis was specifically papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary.

rejected.label: Primary peritoneal carcinoma
rejected.why: There is no indication that the patient's cancer originated in the peritoneum.

rejected.label: Metastatic gastrointestinal cancer
rejected.why: The patient's cancer originated in the ovary, not the gastrointestinal tract.

rejected.label: Ovarian clear cell carcinoma
rejected.why: The patient's initial diagnosis was papillary serous adenocarcinoma of the ovary, not clear cell carcinoma.
